## ANTI-AI-SLOP
Regressive UX removal of core navigation paths.

## FINDINGS
I am revoking the prior approval for this PR. While the cleanup of arbitrary Tailwind variables was successful, the densification process removed the `<PathSelector />` from the Dashboard. The dual paths front page navigation is a critical user flow for resolving their intent immediately upon landing. Please restore the dual path UI element to the application front page.

## FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Not Approved

comments.body: The removal of `<PathSelector />` has caused a significant UX degradation by eliminating the dual path front page. Please restore `.PathSelector />` to the dashboard layout.
